Digital artist nohygiene creates surreal 3D characters that combine angelic imagery, early-internet aesthetics and intensely emotional scenes. Her recurring figures have oversized heads, metallic or pale bodies, long hair and wings. They appear alone, exhausted, in love or overwhelmed, while simple symbols such (Artvangarde)as hearts, fire and tears make their emotions immediately visible. The deliberately imperfect graphics recall early 3D animation, online avatars and old computer imagery, rather than the polished realism of contemporary CGI. Across her work, these strange digital beings (Artvangarde)become vessels for very human feelings love, loneliness, anxiety, desire and emotional vulnerability. #art #loveyou #artist #niche #heart

¿Qué es el arte digital? 🌐      Cuando hablamos de arte digital la tecnología no tiene que ser el único medio de creación, con el simple hecho de que haya una intervención tecnológica, o algún elemento añadido con el ordenador, la pieza es considerada digital. Esta forma de arte puede ser generada totalmente por una computadora, escaneada, dibujada o editada utilizando un mouse o una tableta.        El arte es, pues, ante todo, experiencia. Sensaciones como resultado de pensamientos compartidos, que juntos conforman experiencias. ❔What is digital marketing ❔ Digital marketing encompasses all marketing efforts that use electronic devices or the internet. In today’s digital age, businesses leverage various digital channels such as search engines, social media, email, websites, and mobile apps to connect with current and prospective customers. 🔹Social Media Marketing  🔸SEO (Search Engine Optimization) 🔹Content Marketing  🔸Email Marketing  🔹PPC (Pay Per Click) 🔸Affiliate Marketing  🔹Digital Analytics  Why is Digital Marketing important? 👇🏻👇🏻 1️⃣ Reach: With billions of people online, digital marketing allows businesses to reach a global audience regardless of their size or location. 2️⃣ Targeting: Digital marketing enables precise targeting, allowing businesses to reach specific demographics, interests, behaviors, and locations. 3️⃣ Cost-Effective: Compared to traditional marketing methods, digital marketing often offers a higher return on investment (ROI) and allows for more cost-effective campaigns. 4️⃣ Measurable Results: Unlike traditional marketing, digital marketing provides detailed analytics and insights, allowing businesses to track the performance of their campaigns in real-time and make data-driven decisions 📲 Digital marketing is an essential aspect of modern business strategy, helping businesses connect with their target audience, increase brand awareness, drive traffic, and ultimately, generate leads and sales in an increasingly digital world. #DigitalMarketing #OnlineMarketing #SocialMediaMarketing #ContentMarketing #SEO #EmailMarketing #AffiliateMarketing #DigitalNomad #InternetBusiness #Entrepreneurship #PassiveIncome #SideHustle #MakeMoneyOnline #FinancialFreedom #DigitalEntrepreneur #OnlineBusiness #WorkFromAnywhere #Ecommerce #MonetizeYourPassion #DigitalStrategy #chatgpt #fyp #fypシ #fypシ゚viral #trending #businesstiktok
